name: CSMIC VR
summary:
**Beyond listening.**

CSMIC surrounds your music with colour, light and movement. Pick your mood, choose a track and watch the sound take shape around you.

**Six moods to explore**

Discover Bright, Dark, Energetic, Hopeful, Relaxing and Suspense—each offering a different atmosphere for your listening session.

**One track. Four ways to feel it.**

Switch between Spectrum, Circle, Expanding Ring and Sphere. Audio-reactive bars, fine rays, trails and surrounding particles respond to the music.
